DDInter82.mechanism: Ammonium chloride may increase urinary excretion of tricyclic antidepressants by acidifying the urine.

DDInter84.mechanism: Urinary acidifying agents such as ammonium chloride, sodium acid phosphate, and methenamine salts may lower the blood levels and efficacy of amphetamines. Acidifying the urine has been reported to increase the concentration of the ionized species of the amphetamine molecule, thereby inhibiting renal tubular absorption and increasing its urinary excretion.
